title: macOS Microphone Permission Flow
requirements: Wrap AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess(for:) in withCheckedThrowingContinuation with a 5-second timeout — on timeout resume throwing RecorderError.permissionTimeout, never hang

When authorizationStatus is .denied, throw RecorderError.permissionDenied; when .notDetermined and no callback fires within the timeout, throw permissionDenied with the same recovery guidance rather than hanging

Add an 'Open System Settings' affordance (visible Button in the recording sheet) that opens System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone via NSWorkspace.shared.open with a safe unwrap; surface permission errors via an inline label alongside it
acceptance_criteria: A first-launch attempt to record either prompts correctly, fails fast within 5 seconds, or guides the user to Settings within 5 seconds
swift test --sanitize=thread passes — no race warnings on PermissionManager
RecorderError.permissionTimeout and RecorderError.permissionDenied both conform to LocalizedError with distinct errorDescription values
out_of_scope: Runtime re-prompt after .denied (system requires manual user action in Settings)
